**Issue #1864 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1864: Patch: Stinkyscape S08, the trade cards
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape set, a card part. It builds on `main` behind R1420's gate, so no player meets these cards before the release, the last part of #1856.

## Scope

- **Cards**: `#87` Siva 1, `#164` The Syndicate, `#165` The Trade Union
- **Uses, already on `main`**: #1838

The Syndicate is a Field Spell (the designer's answer). Its two chances are exclusive (30% exiled, else 30% Radiant; 70% on the Radiant face). The Trade Union's Radiant face allows two Trades a turn.

## Reading

Each card's entry is in the foundation's card-by-card brief (`docs/stinkyscape-set.md` once #1857 has merged); the designer's words are `JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`. The plan's fixes (ST8) and the designer's answers (ST9) win over the designer's words.

## Done when

- Each card's script, `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/cNNN_slug.rs` (filling the foundation's stub), returns `Vec<Effect>` built from the engine's verbs and reads state through the prelude alone (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6), with tests in the same file for its base and its Radiant behaviour and its BUILD M12 rows green.
- A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (`crates/cards/README.md`); a decision the spec does not make gets a ruling note from this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- The cards' own rows (§8.10, §7, BUILD M12, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, the catalog entry) are corrected where the build decides otherwise, and the pull request says so.
- The set stays held by R1420's gate: no pending fragment, no golden trace moves, the shipped totals unchanged.
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST6, ST8, ST9); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Blocked by #1857

Part of #1856.
```

# Plan draft for #1864 (S08: Siva 1, The Syndicate, The Trade Union)

## Found so far
- #1857 merged (5e04fd9d7): stubs at crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c087_siva_1.rs, c164_the_syndicate.rs, c165_the_trade_union.rs.
- Brief: docs/stinkyscape-set.md lines ~2080 (S87), ~3211 (S164), ~3224 (S165); proposed rulings ST-S08-1..5 (B16, B17, B26, B27, B28 at ~3731).
- Catalog rows exist (params: S164 exileChance 30/30, radiantChance 30/70; S165 trades 2, tunedOn radiant).
- BUILD.md M12 rows: line 1264 (S 87), 1351 (S 164), 1352 (S 165). spec/08-catalog.md rows 671, 758, 759. docs/radiant-audit.md 789, 876, 877.
- Engine trade: crates/engine/src/trade.rs (trades_per_turn_of reads PlayerState.trades_per_turn: Option<i32>; apply_trade pushes GameEvent::Traded{player}, then draw::shuffle_into_library, then draw::draw).
- Ruling block: R1864000.. (none exist yet).

## Decisions so far (see journal)
- is_tradable must read aura layer: change trade::is_tradable to crate::layers::unit_has(state, card, KeywordKind::Tradable) (as alt_play::is_cloaked). unit_view keywords ⊇ card_keywords for hand cards -> shipped games unchanged.
- Trade Union Radiant: new Script hook `trades_per_turn: Option<TradesPerTurnHook>` (same type shape as RevealEchoHook, Fn(HookArgs)->i32), read in trade::trades_per_turn_of as max(own figure, each acting card's), copy alt_play::reveal_echo_bonus loop; fuse.rs combine_objects add `trades_per_turn: largest_read(...)`. Card: radiant.then(|| Arc::new(|args| param(&args, "trades"))) like meditative/c099_paranoia.rs.
- Syndicate: can NOT change GameEvent::Traded (classify stage 2 compares events e/v/s of 200 unforced shipped games; Prestige/Showdown trade => divergence => fragment needed). Chosen: triggers::queue_trigger adds `tradedId` to the entry data for a Traded event = first ShuffledIn{player} still in state.dispatch (apply_trade pushes Traded then ShuffledIn, R1838001 order). Reader trade::traded_card_of(ctx). Only when a trigger answers Traded (none shipped) -> no divergence.
- Syndicate trigger roll in TriggerDef run with ctx.rng (hook-time rng as meditative c054 v0_3_7b), R129 no roll when card not in trader's library.
- Siva 1: card-only, K-Pop's Allure pattern (delay RESUME_HOOK step "steal" + resume steal otherwise Destroy, mark ALLURE_MARK pink). Candidates = allure_enemy_units' walk (slots_of(enemy, Row::Units)+card_at, then standing_units_of) minus is_slumbering, filtered tags_of contains Tag::Acclaimed; pick with ctx.rng.pick in Cry hook (R129 none->no draw). Radiant none: summon_random {query {type Unit, tags [Acclaimed]}, player enemy} + for_each_card(summoned_so_far) freeze + for_each_card allure (pattern meditative c059).
- Rulings: R1864000 Siva base, R1864001 Siva radiant, R1864002 aura-lent Tradable (is_tradable via layers), R1864003 Syndicate roll + traded_card_of handoff, R1864004 Trades a turn hook.
- Luau: allyAttacked/evolve are not in crates/luau vm::HOOKS -> new Script hook needs no Luau binding. No new effect verbs (avoids luau api + jackioh.luau regen).
- Test shipped Acclaimed unit: classicplus-037 Wardrum (5/5). VANILLA core-008, FILLER core-005.
